convert_hf_to_fairseq2_state_dict: convert a HuggingFace Gemma3n state dictionary to fairseq2 format using convert_gemma3n_state_dict
export_fairseq2_to_hf: export a fairseq2 Gemma3n model to HuggingFace format using export_gemma3n
review_HG_KEY_MAP: review the HuggingFace to fairseq2 parameter key mapping regex patterns in _HG_KEY_MAP
convert_pointwise_conv_weights: reshape pointwise conv weights from HF Linear to fairseq2 Conv1d format during state dict conversion
convert_to_hf_config: convert a fairseq2 Gemma3nConfig to a HuggingFace Gemma3nTextConfig dictionary using _convert_to_hg_config
